sentences.text: Chandreyi Biswas Dutta vs Unknown on 3 October, 2025

IN THE HIGH COURT AT CALCUTTA Court No.07  Item No.01 CRIMINAL MISCELLANEOUS JURISDICTION (Not Pressed)
 CRM (DB) 68 of 2025  AB/SR In Re:- An application for bail under 483(3) of the Bharatiya Nagarik  Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 filed in connection with
All Women Police  Station, Kharagpur (Town) Case No. 75 of 2025 dated 18.11.2021

under Sections 498A/323/307/406/506/509/34 of the Indian Penal  Code and Sections 3/ 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act;
 And  In the matter of :Chandreyi Biswas Dutta.

1. 
At the time of hearing, Ms. Poulami Bose, learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits before this Court that the similar such bail application has already been disposed of.
2. Accordingly, she submits that she wants to not press the instant bail application.
3. In view of such, CRM 86 of 2025 is dismissed as 'not pressed'.

(Partha Sarathi Sen, J.)
